messages.author: 0cc91f41491ff09e
messages.subject: Outmessage
parts:
Hi Phil,

I have a question together with a suggestion for the next version of the package:
Most parts of the mirtCAT GUI can be configured using the shinyGUI, for example title, authors, and instructions. This is very helpful is you want to run mirtCAT in a non english-speaking country. For some reason, this appears to not be the case for the outmessage "please provide a suitable response".
Thus my question: Is there currently a way to change the outmessage (other than changing the whole package)?

My suggestion would be to add the outmessage to the customizable aspects in shinyGUI so that the outmessage can be adapted and mirtCAT would be entirely usable in other languages :-) 

Thanks in Advance,

Daniel

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Outmessage
parts:
Hi Daniel,

This is a nice request, and likely present in other areas of mirtCAT. Would you mind opening an issue on Github where we can track this feature request more easily? Thanks.

Phil
